title: DoS attack on Aegis Vault when staking is enabled
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  When Aegis Vault's staking capability is enabled, `preAction` and `postAction` functions are executed within important operations. These actions interact with the Berachain reward vault. `preAction` will unstake, claim rewards, and transfer the rewards to the farming contract, while `postAction` will stake the ICHI shares back into the Berachain reward vault.
